notes.title: What is SOULGRAVE
notes.notes:
[p]It’s been about a month since I put [b]SOULGRAVE[/b] up on Steam, and it’s been really cool to see people checking it out, wishlisting it, and sharing it around (more of that, please).[/p][p]So, I figured it was time to properly introduce the game.
Though, please bear with me. I’ve never really written devlogs before and generally have no idea what I’m doing. Which I hear is very on-brand for indie development.[/p][h1]
[b]SOULGRAVE is a 2D action roguelite[/b][/h1][p]You’ll dive into [b]procedurally generated dungeons[/b] scattered across five distinct [b]shards[/b], broken fragments of a world that was torn apart in an ancient calamity.[/p][p]Each shard represents a fractured part of the human psyche: [b]fear, joy, rage, memory[/b], etc.
They aren’t just aesthetic themes. They change how the game plays:[/p][list][*][p]Unique [b]visual identities[/b] and environmental effects[/p][/*][*][p]Varied [b]layouts, hazards, and[/b] [b]gameplay feel[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Shard-specific [b]mechanical twists[/b], items, and unlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Distinct [b]bosses and encounter experiences[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After each successful run, you’ll unlock new [b]difficulty levels[/b]. Dungeons will evolve:[/p][p]Expect upgraded enemies with new moves, harder new and unique boss mechanics, additional loot pools, and more surprises.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638514/3e0620f3d0fe1b271957829d372174178c9253dd.png"][/img]Some locations from different Shards[/p][p][/p][h1][b]The combat is fast and encourages creativity[/b][/h1][p]You’ll have access to:[/p][list][*][p]3 [b]Active Skills[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Swappable [b]Tools[/b] (think active-use items)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passive Items [/b]you can stack[/p][/*][/list][p]Everything can be upgraded, rerolled, or fused mid-run. Abilities synergize with specific items and tools, opening up the potential for wild builds. One run might turn you into a teleporting shadow reaper; the next, a floating arsenal of flame mines and summoned scythes. My goal is to make every run feel different, and sometimes downright unhinged. And balancing it all is a problem for future me.

[i]I’ll go into more detail on the itemization and randomness in a future post. Just know there’s already a very cursed Google Sheet full of ideas and synergy combos. If you want to contribute to insanity, join the [/i][url="https://discord.gg/DfeCThKQ"]Discord.[/url][i] I'll listen to your wild ideas.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638514/35a5b03b9c32f6da156120d0880c57f820f9bea6.gif"][/img]
A bit of general combat from Redveil Grave[/p][h1]
[b]Bosses as the main course[/b][/h1][p]Each shard ends in one of several [b]handcrafted boss fights[/b]. There is no procedural randomness, just raw design.[/p][p]Bosses in SOULGRAVE are closer to MMO raid encounters than typical roguelike brawls. That means:[/p][list][*][p][b]Telegraphed attacks[/b] with visual cues you’ll need to learn[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mechanics that evolve over the fight[/b] - the boss will usually start with a concept you need to understand, and then build on top of it with additional layers of complexity[/p][/*][*][p][b]Puzzle-like patterns,[/b] where paying attention and understanding what the boss is cooking is just as important as dodging it[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moments of panic[/b] when you realize you’ve misread a mechanic and now the floor is lava[/p][/*][*][p]And yes, sometimes the solution [i]is[/i] to hit the boss harder. But only sometimes, when the boss is tired of dancing with you.[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m not aiming for basic dodge rolls or bullet hell. I want you to pay attention. The goal is to create [b]unique and memorable[/b], fair fights once you understand the rules. Which, granted, might be written in glowing glyphs while the boss charges an arena-wiping deathorb.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638514/ca5872aa2f9b27a57584854d4339ff66355909b9.gif"][/img]Erebus - the Black Tribunals enrage[/p][p][/p][h1][b]What’s next?[/b][/h1][p]
In the next devlog, I’ll go deeper into:[/p][list][*][p][b]Combat mechanics and build synergy[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlockables, meta progression, and long-term goals[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Playable character(s?)[/b] and their stories[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lore breakdown[/b]. What the shards really are[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss design deep dive[/b] - the philosophy behind the encounters[/p][/*][*][p]??? let me know if you want to know something specific about the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]Thanks for reading, thanks for wishlisting, and thanks for being interested in this weird, severely overscoped and recklessly ambitious solo dev project. It means a lot.[/h3][p][/p][p]More soon,
